title: Health access in Rwanda
question: How many people in Rwanda live more than 5 km from a public health facility, district by district?

sources.name: Kontur Population: Rwanda, population density for 400m H3 hexagons
sources.credit: Kontur Population, Kontur Inc., via the Humanitarian Data Exchange

sources.name: Public health facilities in sub-Saharan Africa, Maina et al. (2019)
sources.credit: Snow RW, Maina J, Ouma PO, Macharia PM, Alegana VA, Mitto B, et al. (2019). Public health facilities in sub Saharan Africa. figshare. doi:10.6084/m9.figshare.7725374.v1

sources.name: geoBoundaries Rwanda districts (ADM2), from Open Data Rwanda
sources.credit: geoBoundaries (www.geoboundaries.org), Runfola et al. (2020); boundaries from Open Data Rwanda

howMade.question:
Five kilometres is about an hour's walk, and for many people in rural Rwanda walking is how they reach a clinic. How many people live further than that from the nearest public health facility, and in which districts?

The workflow takes Kontur's population grid (hexagons about 400 m across), finds the nearest public health facility in the Maina et al. inventory to the middle of each hexagon, keeps the people more than 5 km away, and adds them up per district with two spatial joins, the second beside the district's whole population, so a SQL step can give each district its share. The nearest facility is found by a SQL step that measures on the ellipsoid: the nearest join measures within one UTM zone, and Rwanda straddles two.

The distance is a straight line, not the road or the path people actually take: it understates the real journey, most in the hills. About 177,000 people live in hexagons whose middle lies across the border, and no district counts them.

datasets.made: All 24,764 populated H3 hexagons of the 2023-11-01 release, 14.3 million people, read from Kontur's address on HDX on 2026-10-25; turned from Web Mercator into longitude and latitude.

datasets.source: Public health facilities in sub-Saharan Africa, Maina et al. (2019)
datasets.made: The inventory's 572 facilities in Rwanda, read from figshare article 7725374 version 1 on 2026-10-25; name, type, ownership and province kept, placed by their latitude and longitude.

datasets.source: geoBoundaries Rwanda districts (ADM2), from Open Data Rwanda
datasets.made: The 30 district outlines, simplified, read from the geoBoundaries repository at commit 9469f09 on 2026-10-25; the district name kept.

styling: Every populated hexagon coloured by the straight-line distance to its nearest public health facility: under 2 km, 2 to 5, 5 to 10, 10 km or more.
The districts outlined and labelled with the share of their people more than 5 km from a facility.
Every public health facility as a small dark point.
Widgets: the people in each distance band, filtering the hexagons; the people more than 5 km away; the facilities.
The camera holds the whole country; the basemap follows the light or dark theme.
